name: matrix reassemble
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 重新组织系统矩阵自由度及带宽的处理。
usage_overview: 用于轨道与下部结构耦合系统的矩阵处理，通过按空间位置重新排列自由度及相应矩阵行列，缩小耦合矩阵带宽，为系统的高效计算组织矩阵。

complete_examples.text: The fastener force of train–track–subgrade model with matrix reassemble method is extracted and taken as the load of ABAQUS model.
Appendix 4 The pseudo-code procedure of track matrix reassemble method in MATLAB platform is presented.
